planner.goal: If Tibo's next goal is to {{goal}}: is that the best thing now? Rank in this order. If health is under 40%, or a boss is within 200 units, food or evading comes first. Otherwise: opening a chest first (free pick, and it evolves weapons), fighting an elite next (it drops a chest), then collecting nearby xp gems, then exploring for new chests. Do not evade just because many pests are around; the weapons handle them. Skip anything that walks Tibo directly into a boss.
planner.pick: Tibo is at a {{choice}}. Which option makes Tibo strongest? Commit to one evolution line: level the weapon that has its catalyst passive held or on offer (Steam Vent with Root Network, Locked Gatling with Masher Grip) and take the catalyst when offered. Never take Reroll when a useful card is shown. Take Gravy Heart for max hp early. Keep damage passives (Butter Pat, Hot Sauce) next, and prefer armor and dodge items when offered.

action.hurt: If Tibo does this: {{move}}. How badly does it hurt Tibo in the next second?
action.useful: If Tibo does this: {{move}}. Does it bring Tibo closer to its goal ({{goal}})?
action.dash: Is Tibo about to be hit or surrounded, so a quick dash away would save it?

why: The 6:42 death came from a goal prompt that made the bot evade all game and starved chests; the pick prompt also scattered levels. Revert to the proven plain chest-first with a narrower boss rule and add catalyst-focused picks.
